chapter.verse: Corinth khua ah Apollos a om laitak Paul pen mualtung gam teng nawkin Ephesus khua tung hi. Tua takah nungzui kimkhat va mu hi.
Tua ciangin tua mite' kiangah, “Thu na up uh ciangin Kha Siangtho na sang uh hiam?” ci-in dong hi. Amaute in, “Kha Siangtho om cih thu nangawn ka za ngeikei uh hi,” ci uh hi.
“Tua ahihleh bang baptizena sang na hi uh hiam?” ci-in Paul in a dot ciangin amaute in, “John' baptizena,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Paul in, “John' hong baptize pen kisikna vai baptizena hi a, mite' kiangah ama' khit-a a tung ding mipa a up nadingun zong gen hi. Tua pen Jesu ahi hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu a zak uh ciangin tua mite zong Topa Jesu' min tawh kibaptize uh hi.
Amaute' tungah Paul in khut a ngak ciangin a tung uhah Kha Siangtho tung a, kamtuam tawh pau-in kamsang uh hi.
Tua mite a vekun pasal sawmlenih kiim pha uh hi.
Tua ciangin vengkhawm inn ah Paul lutin kha thum sung hangtak thugen a, amaute Pasian' kumpigam thu kuppihin pawlzot hi.

Ahih hangin mi kimkhat lungsim khauhin up loh lam pang uh a, thu-um mipi' mai-ah Topa' Lampi gensia uh hi. Tua ciangin amaute' kiangpan Paul kihemkhia-in nungzuite paikhiatpih a, Tyrannus a kici thugenna sawm-inn ah nisimin thu kuppih hi.
Hih danin kum nih sung kizomsuak ahih manin Asia gam-a teeng, Jew ahi-a Greek ahi zongin, mi khempeuh in Topa' thu za uh hi.
Pasian in Paul' khut tungtawnin nalamdang a namtuam deuhte bawl a,
Paul' pumtung a sukha khin mainul leh angdal puante cinate' kiangah a kipaipih ciangin a natna uh paikhia-in a sung uh pan kha gilote pusuak, cihzah dong ahi hi.
Tua ciangin Jew mi a vakkawn, dawl hawlkhia thei kimkhat in kha gilo neite' tungah Topa Jesu' min zat sawm uh a, “Paul' tangko Jesu' tungtawnin khauhtak kong sawl hi,” ci uh hi.
Sceva minnei Jew siampi lianpenpa' tapa sagihte in tu-a bangin hih uh hi.
Ahih hangin kha gilo in amaute dawng a, “Jesu ka tel a, Paul zong ka thei hi. No zenzen kuate na hi uh hiam?” ci hi.
Tua ciangin kha gilo a lutna mipa in amaute bawh a, a vekun zo dikdek ahih manin amaute a guaktangun sisan naisan tawh tua inn pan taikek uh hi.
Hih thu, Ephesus khua-a teeng, Jew ahi-a Greek ahi zongin, mi khempeuh in a zak a theih uh ciangin vekpi tungah launa tung a, Topa Jesu' min nakpi-in kiphat hi.
Thu-um ahisa mite zong tampi hong pai uh a, a gamtatziate uh genkhia-in pulak uh hi.
Dawisa mibum thei tampite in zong a laibute uh hong tawikhia tek uh a, vekpi' muhna ah haltum uh hi. Tua laibute a manzah a kigawm ciangin nguntang then-nga pha hi.
Tua hi a, Topa' thu pen vangliatna tawh khangin gualzo toto hi.
Hih thu teng khit ciangin Paul in Macedonia gamke leh Achaia gamke teng nawkin Jerusalem ah pai dingin lungsim khensat a, “Tua tak ka tun khit ciangin Rome khua zong ka pha hamtang ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin amah a donte nih, Timothy leh Erastus, Macedonia ah paisak a, amah ahihleh Asia ah tawlkhat sung taam hi.
Tua sawngin Lampi thu hangin buaina a thuneu het lo khat piang hi.
A hang pen ngun tawh Artemis thoihna innnote a bawl Demetrius minnei ngunsek khat in khutsiam nasemte summuhna lianpi ngahsak hi.
Tua mipa in hih mite leh sumzonna kibatpih nasemte kaikhawm a, “Lawmte aw, hih sumzon nasep tawh nuamtak a nungta thei i hihlam na thei uh hi.
Tu-in hih Paul in mihing' khut tawh kibawlte pasian hilo ci-in gen a, Ephesus khua bek hilo, Asia gam khempeuh phial ah mi tampitak pawlzotin lampialsak khinzo hi.

Tua hi a, i sumzon nasepna hong kikosia thei ding banah nusian thupi Artemis thoihna biakinn zong bangmahlo hong suahkhak ding lauhuaina om hi. Amahmah nangawn, Asia bup leh leitung mite' biak nusian takpi, a thupitna hong maimang thei ding hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu a zak uh ciangin amaute nakpi lungso uh a, “Ephesus khuamite' Artemis, thupi-in lian hi!” ci-in awng uh hi.
Tua hangin khuapi sung gamlumna om a, mite in Paul' khualzinpih Macedonia gammi Gaius leh Aristarchus taalkaihin pawi innpi sungah lungsim kituakin nawhlutpih mahmah uh hi.
Paul zong tua mihon kikhopna ah pai nuam ahih hangin nungzuite in phal lo uh hi.
Amah tawh kilawmta Asia gam uliante kimkhat nangawn in pawi innpi sungah Paul a va kilaak loh nadingin ama' kiangah mi sawlin kho uh hi.
Tu-in mihonpi lungbuai-in amau' mun tek pan awng ngeingai uh a, ahih hangin a tamzaw in a kikaihkhopna uh a hang nangawn thei lo uh hi.
Kimkhat in Jew mite' paisak ahi Alexander, mihonpi' mai-ah thugen dingin sawl uh hi. Alexander zong mipi kikhopna mai-ah mawhloh lahtelna thu gen nuam ahih manin mihonpi lam khutvan hi.
Ahih hangin amah Jew mi ahihlam mite in a theih uh ciangin a vekun a kituakin, “Ephesus khuamite' Artemis, thupi hi!” ci-in nai nih sung taang awng uh hi.

Tua ciangin khuasung lai-atpa in mihonpi a daihsak khit ciangin, “Ephesus khuamite aw, eite khuapi Ephesus pen Artemis thoihna inn a kem leh vantung pana hong kiasuk suang siangtho a kem ahihlam a theilo kua om ahi hiam?
Hih thute nialtheih hilo cih thei na hih manun bangmah mawk gamtat lo-in daitak omhuai hi.
A hang pen note in thoihna innpi buluhte lah ahilo, eima' nusian a daisakte zong ahilo, hih mite hih takah nong paipih uh hi.
Tua ahih manin Demetrius leh amah tawh kipawl khutsiam mite in mi khatpeuh tungah lungkimlohna a neih uhleh tu laitak zum zong kihong a, tualsung mangpateg zong om hi. Amau teng thu kibawl ta uh hen.
Tua hilo-in kohnop na neih lai uhleh thukhun khawmpih ah kikhensat ding hi.
A hang pen tuni-a mihon sona a thu a la i gen theih ding om lo ahih manin hih gamlumna thu hangin ei teng thu hong kibawl ding lunghihmawhhuai hi,” ci hi.
Hih thu a gen khit ciangin kikhopna hialbawl hi.
